title: Haven KeyPackages lack room_metadata (0x0023): JMAP-created mimid rooms cannot invite Haven users
description: Live test 2026-11-15 (mimid-1wgh.12.41): inviting mimi://mimi.havenmessenger.com/u/erin into a room made by Room/create fails: a leaf does not support required component 0x0023. Room/create rule 5 needs room_metadata; mls-extensions rule 6 (editor's copy, PR #110) needs a component with state in the GroupContext to be listed in app_components, so required. erin's KeyPackages list 0x21, 0x22, 0x25, 0x27. Needs Haven to list 0x0023 in KeyPackage app_components; ask Jason on interop#1 or Zulip (Mark's OK to post). Then rerun tools/interop/chat jmap-erin.script on the host.
notes:
2026-11-15: not a Haven bug (Mark). Caused by our Room/create rule 5 putting room_metadata in every JMAP room; protocol-07 §7.6 leaves support optional. Fix on our side: mimid-1wgh.12.44 (draft), mimid-1wgh.12.45 (mimid); WG question mimid-1wgh.37.97. Jason gets an informational heads-up only.
